Inst.de actionibus.b à noxia differt ferre ait Iustinianus §.1.PVpillus {d}est,qui,cùm impubes est,desit {e}in patris potestate esse aut morte {f}, aut emancipatione à noxia differt. 1 ¶ Seruorum appellatio ex eo fluxit, quòd Imperatores ||noftri|| captiuos {g}vendere,ac per hoc feruare {h}, nec {i}occidere solent. 2 ¶ Incola est, qui aliqua regione domicilium {k}suum contulit. Inst. de noxa-lib.sed noxa quem Græci παροίκους {l} (id est, ixta habitantem) interdum idem quòd noxia. hinc illæ formulæ, noxam nocere l.45. §.1. ff.de legat. 1. noxiam nocere l. 4. ff. de noxalibus, noxam committere l. 32. ff. de noxalibus, noxiam committere l. 1. ff. si quadrupes. æstimatio noxiæ d. l. 1. noxam caput sequi v.l.1.in fine. ff. de priuatis delictis, hinc noxalis actio ff. de noxalibus. hinc noxij serui, id est, qui nocent l.27.§.11.ff.ad legem Aquiliam. {m} l.1.§.1.ff.de noxalibus: §.1.Inst.de noxalib: 2. Ecloga c.238. non tamen quod publicam coercitionem contineat l.200.ff.eo. Interdum pœnam significat, hinc noxæ dedere l.19.ff.de noxalibus: ad noxam dedere d.l.19. §.af.ff.de noxalib. in noxam l.11.noxam dare l.7.§.1.ff. quod vi: noxæ deditio l.10.ff.de noxalibus: noxis solui, & solutum esse l.200.ff.eo: noxam farcire,& in noxam dare separantur l.1.§.11.ff.de noxalibus. {n} hinc pupillaris ætas quæ anno 14. terminatur l.16. ff.de iure fisci: l.3.Cod.de præscript.30. annorum: pupillares tabulæ l.32.in f.ff.de vulgari, pupillare testamentum l.8.§.5. ff.de inofficioso: l.2.§.2. ff.de vulgari: l.34.§.9.§.10. ff.de legatis i. pupillaris substitutio, quæ fit liberis impuberibus in eum casum, quo ante pubertatis annos decesserint l.2.ff.de vulgari. pupillares substituti l.10. §.5. ff. de vulgari, {o} desiit, si prius fuit in potestate. Qui est in vtero talis nôeft l.262.ff.eo:ad.Ec.l.b.c.239. {p} f his duobus etiâ finitur patroni potestas. Inst.quibus modis patria potestas. {q} ne colligas sola captiuitate seruos fieri, quum etiam alio modo serui fiant v.l.5. §.1.ff. de statu. {r} l.4.in fine ff.de statu.§.2.Inst.de iure personarum 2.Ecl. 2.cap.239. {s} hinc constat, non licere hoftem postquam à nobis captus est occidere,aut de eo supplicium sumere. {t} non ius ciuitatis adquisuit, potest enim quis vnius ciuitatis esse incola, alterius ciuis l.29.ff.ad municipalem: adde l.6. inf. ff.de muneribus. μέτοικος. talis fuit Abrahamus παροίκισε τῆς γῆς τῆς ἐπαγγελίας Heb.5. versic.9. Hinc illud, aduenas nos esse oportet carnis & mundi Petrus 1.cap.2.versic.11. ἐνδημοῦντος παροικίας ὡς παροίκους καὶ παρεπιδήμους τῶν σαρκικῶν ἐπιθυμιῶν. contra,cœli,fidelibus non incolatus, sed propria ciuitas.hinc illud ἀλλ᾽ ἐστὲ συμπολῖται τῶν ἁγίων καὶ οἰκεῖοι τοῦ θεοῦ Ephef.2.vers.19.

page.notes: Left margin notes are printed in very small italic type; their line breaks and the exact pairing of notes to reference marks (a–b, and the letters d–t in the text) are uncertain and may be misplaced. The reference marks in the text were read from the scan and may not all match their notes. The Greek passages at the foot of the column are only partly legible; the letters are approximate and the Greek accents, breathings and spelling should be checked against the scan. "||noftri||" is printed with brackets that could be typographic and not part of the word. The first note "Conuentione contrahitur" may be a running marginal heading. The line "hinc illud" with the Greek is fragmentary and heavily cut by the scan edge. Several citations in the column are printed in small type and may contain errors such as "fisci" for "fiscus" and "Ec." for "Eccl." that are left as printed.
